name: Portfolio Watch
summary: Keeps an eye on your stocks and crypto so you don't have to: the daily close, big moves and your price targets, with your real P&L.
handles: Daily close at 4:30 PM on weekdays: value, day change, total P&L, top movers
Fridays add how the week went
Alerts once per symbol per day on big moves
Price target alerts that fire once
Keeps your trades: average cost and realised gains

fields.label: Your holdings
fields.help: One per line: symbol, quantity, @ what you paid each. Stocks by US ticker; crypto BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, ADA, XRP. Example: AAPL 10 @ 182.50

fields.label: Big move alert (%)
fields.help: Alert me when a holding moves this much in a day, once per symbol per day. Example: 5

after: Add your holdings in Settings, or just tell it "bought 10 aapl at 182.50". Then ask "how am I doing". Quotes may be delayed.
